_comment: Copy to graphify.local.json (gitignored) and fill in real paths. Relative paths resolve against this file's folder; bare exe names use PATH. Env vars GRAPHIFY_EXE / PYTHON_EXE / GRAPHIFY_DASHBOARD_DIRS override the matching keys. graphify_funnel.py also reads skill_scripts (folder holding resolve_graph.py), query_log (default: env GRAPHIFY_QUERY_LOG) and funnel.{hint_live_since, exclude_temp_cwd, exclude_sessions {session-id: reason} or [session-id, ...]}; excluded sessions are smoke/test runs kept out of organic counts. The funnel rejects unknown funnel keys and wrong value types before it runs.
